---
name: Bug report
about: Report a setup or sync problem without private data
---

Before posting, remove tokens, passwords, pairing/queue files, quote text, book files, private archive names and personal paths. Do not attach databases or device backups.

Check the [support guide](https://github.com/skyerus/reader-bridge/blob/main/SUPPORT.md) first. Report vulnerabilities [privately](https://github.com/skyerus/reader-bridge/security/advisories/new).

**What happened?**

**What did you expect?**

**Versions:** Passage version/build or release tag, macOS version, Apple Silicon/Intel, device model/firmware, and KOReader or CrossPoint version. Include Python only for source/CLI use.

**Workflow:** import only, Kindle, CrossPoint, or both; highlights, backups, or reading positions.

**Connection state:** pairing saved or a highlight actually received; reader Wi-Fi state and whether the Mac was awake. Omit addresses and device IDs.

**Step or command:** include options only after redacting personal paths/addresses.

**Redacted diagnostics:** the brief app error/status and screenshot with personal text removed. For source/CLI use, add `python3 setup.py doctor` output. The Mac app does not require Terminal to report a problem.

**Reproduction:** use a disposable test excerpt, not personal account data.
